bank_account_amounts_nonneg.name: bank_account_amounts_nonneg
bank_account_amounts_nonneg.value: "bank_account"."buffer" >= 0 and "bank_account"."amount" >= 0 and ("bank_account"."goal" is null or "bank_account"."goal" >= 0) and ("bank_account"."annual_limit" is null or "bank_account"."annual_limit" >= 0)

income_item_cycle.name: income_item_cycle
income_item_cycle.value: ("income_item"."cycle" = 'monthly' and "income_item"."month" is null) or ("income_item"."cycle" = 'yearly' and "income_item"."month" between 1 and 12)
